name: Lords of War
summary:
Lords of War is a medieval battle game for VR. You don't watch the war from above: you build an army, then stand at its head with a sword in your hand.

BUILD YOUR ARMY
In the Campaign Hall, hire soldiers with the coins you win, set them out as pawns on a sand table, and choose their formation. Twelve kinds of troops each have a part to play: Villagers, Foot Soldiers, Knights, Halberdiers, Berserkers, Cavemen, Archers, Crossbowmen, Fire Mages, Priests, Necromancers, and Skeletons.
